sections.heading:
A 360-degree partner
for *industry events.*
paragraphs: Aayera is a global business information firm that conducts, organises and hosts conferences, summits, trainings and exhibitions. We have successfully conducted projects for international and local clients throughout the Middle East and the Levant. We handle a diverse portfolio, offering 360-degree solutions to a number of industries, encompassing Event Management & Promotions, Exhibitions and Marketing Communication.

Whether the ‘deal’ is capital raising, vendor sales contracts or sourcing a strategic partner, Aayera provides clients with an unprecedented, high-ROI environment for conducting business. An in-house team of experts conducts extensive research in conjunction with recognised thought leaders to ensure that all events are relevant, timely and at the forefront of market and industry trends.
Flexibility and adaptability are key concepts. Our team ensures that all events are tailored to the specific needs of our customers, providing them with a customised and truly unique experience.

hero.intro: Live, interactive online seminars: ask questions in real time, earn a Professional Development Hour, with no travel required.

sections.heading:
Live, interactive
*learning.*
paragraphs: Short for web-based seminar, a webinar is a presentation, lecture, workshop or seminar that's transmitted over the web. A key feature of the webinar is its interactive elements: the ability to give, receive and discuss information. Contrast this with a webcast, in which the data transmission is one way and does not allow interaction between the presenter and the audience.

These online seminars use online software to make them actual live, interactive learning experiences. Participants will be able to ask the instructor questions and get answers in real time. The instructor will be able to conduct polls and ask questions. Participants will receive course materials by email prior to the seminar and will be able to view the instructor's PowerPoint slides during the seminar. These types of online courses have a much higher impact than simply reading material on the web.

Webinars offer exceptional convenience and are very cost effective. They are ideal for brown-bag lunch training. No travel is required, and the site registration fee allows up to 12 participants to attend at each site. All participants can also earn one Professional Development Hour per seminar. This series of webinars is designed for engineers, scientists, university faculty, graduate students, manufacturers and consultants.

sections.heading:
Other typical features
of a *web conference.*

items.title: Live video
items.text: Via webcam or digital video camera.

items.title: VoIP
items.text: Real-time audio communication through the computer via headphones and speakers.

items.title: Recording
items.text: For viewing at a later time by anyone using a unique web address.

items.title: Whiteboard with annotation
items.text: Allowing the presenter and/or attendees to highlight or mark items on the slide presentation, or simply make notes on a blank whiteboard.

items.title: Text chat
items.text: For live question and answer sessions.

items.title: Polls and surveys
items.text: Allows the presenter to conduct questions with multiple-choice answers directed to the audience.

items.title: Screen sharing
items.text: Desktop and application sharing, where participants can view anything the presenter currently has on their screen. Some screen sharing applications allow for remote desktop control, allowing participants to manipulate the presenter's screen, although this is not widely used.

2020-04-08.summary:
Turkey Healthcare Project Delivery 2020 brings together the ecosystem working on successful project delivery to share lessons learned so far. From establishing the legal framework and securing financing to operating and maintaining a profitable hospital, the event explores the entire lifecycle of the agreement from the perspective of all parties. With a local focus, the summit continues from the earlier event, looking at how the world's largest hospitals will be operated and maintained, and sharing best practices and investment opportunities for the second batch of projects in Turkey.

Health is one of the fastest growing sectors in Turkey. An important factor behind Turkey's continued healthcare budget growth is the country's enhanced health insurance coverage and the demand for new healthcare facilities across the country.

2020-03-24.summary:
Africa being one of the largest medical devices markets in the MEA region gives distributor executives and their manufacturer partners a crucial opportunity to understand the key issues that affect their business and customers. This initiative unites the African healthcare sector under one roof, so that investment, business development, the challenges the sector faces and their solutions, healthcare policy, and innovation through technology are discussed in detail. Medical equipment manufacturers and solution providers will also have an opportunity to understand the evolving regulatory framework. The aim is to bring the African healthcare sector to an international standard.

Africa Healthcare Manufacturers & Distributors Summit 2020 is a specialty forum with an exclusive focus on the medical devices supply chain. AHMDS 2020 fosters collaboration between healthcare manufacturers around the world and the distributors present in Africa.

2019-09-11.summary:
According to the IFC & World Bank, the African healthcare sector was valued at USD 35 billion in 2019 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 6%, reaching USD 62 billion by 2024. Fast-growing populations, strong urbanisation, new and severe health challenges, and a growing middle class willing to pay for better treatment are among the factors driving upgrades, expansions and construction of hospitals across the continent.

At the Africa Healthcare Development & Project Delivery Conference 2019 in Johannesburg, South Africa, on 11–12 September 2019, government officials, investors, operators, architects, health bodies, NGOs and contractors meet medical device suppliers, technology and service vendors, distributors, consultants, banks and regulatory bodies.

2018-08-09.summary: The Hybrid Electric Vehicles CONFEX 2018 is India's unique and most comprehensive HEV event, providing an unparalleled platform to address critical information on both the technical developments in hybrid electric vehicle technologies and the business decisions surrounding development and implementation. It also offers attendees the chance to meet industry experts and technology specialists from the entire EV, HEV and EREV supply chain to discuss the topics of greatest interest.
